summary.lv: Eleving Consumer Finance meklē pieredzējušu datu inženieri, kurš izveidos un uzturēs CDC konveijierus no PostgreSQL uz datu platformu, izmantojot Spark, Kafka un Airflow, un veidos DBT modeļus biznesa analītikai.
summary.en: Eleving Consumer Finance is seeking a senior data engineer to build and maintain CDC pipelines from PostgreSQL, develop streaming pipelines with Spark Structured Streaming and Kafka, and create DBT models for business reporting using a medallion architecture.
